description: Evaluation scenarios for the se-generation skill (Stable Audio 3 generate stage).

scenarios.query: Generate a wooden door creaking open sound effect for my game, about 3 seconds.
expected_behavior: Runs scripts/backends/generate_sa3.py with the asset slug from the working directory containing audio-pipeline-output/
Leaves the model on auto (or states small-sfx) rather than choosing medium for a short sound effect
Uses a source/material/space/mic-distance prompt such as 'wooden door creaking open, interior, close mic' instead of a narrative sentence
Does not invent a script or flag that generate_sa3.py does not provide
Verifies the candidate files exist under audio-pipeline-output/<slug>/generate/ and that stages.generate.status is done before reporting success

scenarios.query: I need five different footstep sounds on gravel so it doesn't sound repetitive in game.
expected_behavior: Runs a single generate_sa3.py invocation with --candidates 5 rather than five separate runs
Explains that varying the seed on one prompt is what produces a usable variation set
Includes 'single' in the prompt so the model produces one-shots rather than a walking sequence
Mentions that re-running appends new candidate files instead of overwriting earlier takes
Tells the user to audition the candidates and record the keepers, rather than declaring them good unheard

scenarios.query: Use the medium model for this one, I want the best quality.
expected_behavior: Warns that the medium checkpoint requires Flash Attention 2 and that without it the audio is silently glitchy
States that the backend refuses to run medium without flash_attn rather than writing a broken file
Offers small-sfx as the working alternative, or installing a flash_attn wheel matching torch 2.7.1 / CUDA 12.8 into the sa3 environment
Notes the higher VRAM cost (~5-6.5 GB versus ~2 GB)
Does not attempt to bypass, disable, or work around the flash-attn refusal

scenarios.query: Here is a reference whoosh.wav, make me three more that sound like it.
expected_behavior: Sets requirement.referenceAudio to the reference file path in the manifest
Chooses a high referenceStrength (roughly 0.7-0.9) and explains that higher means closer to the reference
Runs generate_sa3.py with --candidates 3
Confirms the reference file exists before running, since a missing reference is a user_error failure
Does not claim the reference guarantees a matching timbre across a whole stylized set

scenarios.query: I want a 0.3 second UI click sound.
expected_behavior: Explains that Stable Audio 3 cannot reliably generate sub-2-second audio because of its latent frame rate
Notes that the backend generates at least 2 seconds and records requestedDurationSeconds, with trimming happening in the post stage
Keeps requirement.durationSeconds at the length actually wanted rather than inflating it
Writes a transient-focused prompt such as 'short UI click, dry, no tail' so the usable audio sits at the start of the file
Does not present the 2-second floor as a failure or retry the generation to try to get a shorter file

scenarios.query: Can you check the audio pipeline wiring works without burning GPU time?
expected_behavior: Sets AUDIO_PIPELINE_DRY_RUN=1 and runs generate_sa3.py normally
Explains that ffmpeg synthesizes 44.1 kHz stereo placeholder tones and that the manifest is filled in with dryRun: true in the candidate params
Notes that ffmpeg is required even in dry-run mode
Does not present the placeholder tones as usable audio or judge their quality
Optionally runs doctor.py --stack sa3 to report what a real run would still need
